name: Fujiwara no Shunzei
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 83); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1204.

poems.title: From pain and sorrow all around
poems.author: Fujiwara no Shunzei
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 83
poems.text:
From pain and sorrow all around
There ’s no escape, I fear;
To mountain wilds should I retreat,
There also I should hear
The cry of hunted deer.
